- Pool sizing: for your steady-state we recommend an initial committed pool of 12 A100-equivalent vGPUs with a 25% burst buffer (burst pool) to cover short spikes to ~35k tokens/sec. That configuration delivered ~p95 latency comparable to demo runs in our benchmarks. We can model this more precisely if you share token length distribution and concurrency.
- Billing cadence: annual prepay gets the largest discount (we show a 12% list here) and guarantees capacity. Monthly prepay keeps flexibility but is ~9–11% more expensive on a unit basis.
- True-ups: standard is quarterly true-up for committed capacity (reconcile committed vGPU-hours vs usage and invoice or credit at quarter end). Annual true-up is optional for customers who want a single reconciliation.
- PO/terms: we typically ask for Net30 for billed invoices. For larger enterprise deals we can consider Net45 by signing a short payment amendment and running a credit check.
